commands: P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; test -d "$P/.git"; O=$(git -C "$P" remote get-url origin); case "$O" in https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller|https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|git@github.com:MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|ssh://git@github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git) ;; *) echo BOUND_REPO_MISMATCH; exit 42;; esac; test -z "$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain)"; git -C "$P" fetch -q --prune origin

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; test "$(git -C "$P" branch --show-current)" = main; git -C "$P" merge --ff-only origin/main; test "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse origin/main)"; printf 'MAIN_SYNCED=%s\n' "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)"

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; WT=$(git -C "$P" worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's#^branch refs/heads/##p'); printf '%s\n' '=== DELETE SAFE MERGED LOCAL BRANCHES ==='; while IFS= read -r b; do test "$b" = main && continue; if printf '%s\n' "$WT" | grep -Fxq "$b"; then echo "KEEP_WORKTREE $b"; continue; fi; if git -C "$P" merge-base --is-ancestor "$b" origin/main 2>/dev/null; then git -C "$P" branch -d "$b"; else echo "KEEP_UNMERGED $b"; fi; done < <(git -C "$P" for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/heads | sort)

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; git -C "$P" fetch -q --prune origin; printf '%s
' '=== FINAL LOCAL BRANCHES ==='; git -C "$P" for-each-ref --sort=-committerdate --format='%(refname:short)|%(objectname:short)|%(upstream:short)|%(subject)' refs/heads; printf '%s
' '=== FINAL REMOTE TRACKING ==='; git -C "$P" for-each-ref --sort=-committerdate --format='%(refname:short)|%(objectname:short)' refs/remotes/origin | grep -v '^origin/HEAD|'; printf '%s
' '=== STATUS ==='; git -C "$P" status --short --branch
